N1.s: Bạn đã dùng hết %lld cutling miễn phí. Tiếp tục trong Cutling để mở khóa và lưu cutling này.
N1.back: You have used up 5 cutling free. Continue in Cutling to unlock and save cutling this.
N1.why: Opens with the same 'dùng hết … cutling miễn phí' as S3; 'Tiếp tục' is the vocabulary's continue word, matching the choice the system offers, and 'lưu cutling này' says this very item gets saved.

N2.s: Bạn đã dùng hết %lld cutling miễn phí. Vào Cutling để mở khóa và lưu thêm.
N2.back: You have used up 5 cutling free. Go-into Cutling to unlock and save more.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1 so the two Shortcut replies agree; 'vào' is how Vietnamese speakers say opening an app, and it avoids 'Mở Cutling để mở khóa' with 'mở' twice.

N3.s: Đã lưu, còn một chỗ miễn phí
N3.back: Already saved, remain one place free
N3.why: 'chỗ' is the word S6 uses for room; 'còn một' (one left) is the everyday count, and the comma join follows K1's capsule.

N4.s: Đã lưu, đã dùng %lld/%lld miễn phí
N4.why: Two finished actions each take 'đã', as Vietnamese says it; the '%lld/%lld miễn phí' pair is S29's form, so the keyboard and the list subtitle read the same.

N5.s: Hết %lld/%lld miễn phí, mở khóa để lưu cái này
N5.back: Out-of 5/5 free, unlock to save thing this
N5.why: 'cái này' (this one) is the spoken way to point at the thing being saved and keeps the bar at 40; 'hết' echoes K1's 'Đã hết' with the subject dropped, as a status bar would.

N6.why: The same bare verb as S15, the button word Vietnamese apps use for an unlock.

N7.s: Bạn đã dùng hết %lld cutling miễn phí. Mở khóa Cutling để lưu cutling này.
N7.back: You have used up 5 cutling free. Unlock Cutling to save cutling this.
N7.why: Same first sentence as N1 and N2; 'Mở khóa Cutling' is M1's command, capital for the app and lower case for the item, as the vocabulary separates them.

N8.s: Cutling này vẫn được giữ cho bạn. Vào Cutling và mở khóa để lưu.
N8.back: Cutling this still got kept for you. Go-into Cutling and unlock to save.
N8.why: 'vẫn được giữ' (still kept) tells the person first that nothing was lost; 'Vào Cutling' repeats N2's wording for opening the app.
